trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with an error rate of 0.18 and unhealthy status in all production regions.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` showed v2.3.1 deployed to us-east, us-west, and eu-west, all unhealthy. `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).
3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer. (First attempt was rate-limited; retried successfully.)

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.
